privacy.effectiveDate: 生效日期：2026 年 2 月 4 日 — 最后更新：2026 年 3 月 10 日
privacy.intro: 本隐私政策描述了当您使用 AstroDating 移动应用程序（「本应用」）时，AstroDating 如何收集、使用和保护您的个人数据。它说明我们收集哪些信息、如何处理这些信息、与谁共享以及您对数据享有的权利。
privacy.s0_text: 负责您个人数据的数据控制者是：
privacy.s0_address: 1234 Constellation Way, Suite 500, San Francisco, CA 94105, 美国
privacy.s1_1_ex1: 姓名、电子邮件地址、密码、社交登录令牌（Google、Apple、Facebook）
privacy.s1_1_ex2: 照片（最多 6 张）、个人简介、年龄、性别、职业、兴趣爱好、交友意向
privacy.s1_1_ex3: 出生日期、出生时间、出生城市、出生坐标、太阳/月亮/上升星座、完整本命星盘
privacy.s1_1_ex4: 年龄范围、最大距离、性别偏好、星座筛选、元素筛选、兼容度阈值
privacy.s1_1_ex5: 与其他用户交换的文字消息
privacy.s1_1_ex6: 您联系客服团队时发送的任何内容
privacy.s1_2_ex1: 设备型号、操作系统、唯一设备标识符、IP 地址、应用版本
privacy.s1_2_ex2: 城市、纬度和经度（用于向其他用户显示大致距离；确切坐标永远不会向他人展示）
privacy.s1_2_ex3: 滑动操作（喜欢、超级喜欢、跳过）、匹配、功能使用情况、最后活跃时间戳、引导流程完成状态
privacy.s1_2_ex4: 通过 Sentry 收集的错误堆栈跟踪、会话数据和性能指标（开发版本中已禁用）
privacy.s1_2_ex5: Expo 推送令牌和设备类型，仅用于发送您已选择接收的通知
privacy.s1_3_social: 社交登录提供商 — 当您通过 Google、Apple 或 Facebook 登录时，我们会根据提供商的许可接收您的姓名和电子邮件地址（以及可用的个人头像）。
privacy.s1_3_geo: 地理编码 — 我们使用 OpenStreetMap / Nominatim 将城市名称转换为坐标。这些请求中不会发送任何个人标识信息。
privacy.s2: 2. 我们如何使用您的数据
privacy.s2_provide: 提供服务 — 创建您的账户、展示您的个人资料、计算您的星盘、计算兼容度评分、实现匹配和即时通讯功能。
privacy.s2_personalize: 个性化 — 向您展示符合您发现偏好和占星兼容度的个人资料。
privacy.s2_safety: 安全与诚信 — 检测和防范欺诈行为，执行服务条款，处理用户屏蔽和举报操作。
privacy.s2_comm: 通讯 — 发送新匹配、消息和重要服务更新的推送通知。
privacy.s2_subs: 订阅管理 — 通过 RevenueCat 处理和管理高级订阅及应用内购买；追踪功能权限和试用使用情况。
privacy.s2_improve: 改进与分析 — 了解使用模式，诊断崩溃问题（通过 Sentry），改进本应用。
privacy.s2_legal: 法律合规 — 回应执法机关的合法请求，维护我们的合法权益。
privacy.s3_intro: 您提供的部分信息在适用法律下可能被视为敏感数据，包括：
privacy.s3_item1: 出生日期和时间、出生地点（占星数据）
privacy.s3_note: 这些数据由您自愿提供，仅用于实现本应用的核心功能（星盘计算、兼容度匹配、基于距离的发现）。我们不会出售敏感数据，也不会将其用于广告目的。
privacy.s4: 4. 我们如何共享您的数据
privacy.s4_1_text: 您的个人资料信息（姓名、年龄、照片、个人简介、职业、兴趣、星座、兼容度评分）在发现过程中和匹配后对其他用户可见。您的确切位置永远不会显示；仅显示大致距离。消息内容仅对您和收件人可见。
privacy.s4_2_note: 每个提供商仅代表我们处理数据，并在合同义务下保护数据。
privacy.s4_3_text: 如果法律、法规、法律程序或政府要求，或为了保护 AstroDating、我们的用户或公众的权利、安全或财产，我们可能会披露您的数据。
privacy.s4_4_text: 如果 AstroDating 参与合并、收购或资产出售，您的个人数据可能作为该交易的一部分被转让。我们将就任何此类变更通知您。
privacy.s5_active: 活跃账户 — 只要您的账户处于活跃状态且为提供服务所需，我们就会保留您的数据。
privacy.s5_deleted: 已删除账户 — 当您删除账户时，我们会在 30 天内删除或匿名化您的个人数据，除非法律要求保留或需要解决争议。
privacy.s5_messages: 消息 — 当双方参与者都已删除账户或匹配被移除时，消息将被删除。
privacy.s5_crash: 崩溃报告 — Sentry 数据最多保留 90 天。
privacy.s5_legal: 法律保留 — 如果正在进行法律程序或存在监管义务，数据可能会被保留更长时间。
privacy.s6_intro: 我们采取行业标准措施来保护您的数据，包括：
privacy.s6_tls: 传输加密（所有 API 通信均使用 TLS/HTTPS）
privacy.s6_rest: 存储数据静态加密（Supabase 托管加密）
privacy.s6_rls: 数据库中的行级安全策略，防止未授权访问
privacy.s6_tokens: 安全的身份验证令牌处理
privacy.s6_hash: 密码散列（由 Supabase Auth 处理；我们绝不存储明文密码）
privacy.s6_note: 没有任何系统是完全安全的。尽管我们努力保护您的数据，但无法保证绝对安全。
privacy.s7_intro: 根据您所在的司法管辖区，您可能享有以下权利：
privacy.s7_access: 访问权 — 要求获取我们持有的您的个人数据副本。
privacy.s7_correction: 更正权 — 要求更正不准确或不完整的数据。
privacy.s7_deletion: 删除权 — 要求删除您的个人数据。
privacy.s7_portability: 数据可携带权 — 以结构化、机器可读的格式接收您的数据。
privacy.s7_objection: 反对/限制权 — 反对或要求限制某些数据处理活动。
privacy.s7_withdraw: 撤回同意权 — 在基于同意进行处理的情况下，您可以随时撤回同意，且不影响撤回前处理的合法性。
privacy.s7_ctrl1: 随时从「个人资料」标签编辑或删除您的个人资料信息。
privacy.s7_ctrl2: 从「设置」中调整发现偏好（年龄、距离、星座筛选）。
privacy.s7_ctrl3: 屏蔽任何用户以阻止进一步互动。
privacy.s7_ctrl4: 从「设置」屏幕删除您的账户，这将触发您的数据移除。
privacy.s7_ctrl5: 通过设备设置管理推送通知权限。
privacy.s7_ccpa: 加利福尼亚州居民（CCPA / CPRA）
privacy.s7_ccpa_intro: 如果您是加利福尼亚州居民，根据《加利福尼亚消费者隐私法》，您享有以下额外权利：
privacy.s7_ccpa1: 了解我们收集哪些个人信息以及如何使用这些信息的权利。
privacy.s7_ccpa2: 要求删除您的个人信息的权利。
privacy.s7_ccpa3: 选择退出个人信息「出售」或「共享」的权利。我们不会出售您的个人数据。
privacy.s7_ccpa4: 因行使隐私权而不受歧视的权利。
privacy.s7_gdpr_intro: 如果您位于欧洲经济区或英国，我们处理数据的法律依据如下所示。您还有权向当地数据保护机构提出投诉。
privacy.s7_profiling: 用户画像和自动化决策
privacy.s7_profiling_intro: AstroDating 使用自动化处理来计算用户之间的兼容度分数。具体运作方式如下：
privacy.s7_profiling_what: 我们的做法：我们使用占星合盘算法分析您的星盘数据（行星位置、宫位、相位）以及其他用户的数据，生成兼容度百分比。
privacy.s7_profiling_impact: 影响：兼容度分数会影响个人资料在发现信息流中的显示顺序。兼容度分数较高的资料会优先显示。这不会影响您查看任何资料或发起联系的能力——所有用户仍可访问。
privacy.s7_profiling_logic: 涉及的逻辑：该算法评估您的星盘与其他用户星盘之间的行星相位（合相、三分相、四分相、对分相、六分相），特别重视个人行星（太阳、月亮、金星、火星）和关系宫位（第5、7、8宫）。
privacy.s7_profiling_rights: 您的权利：根据 GDPR 第22条，您有权要求对任何对您有重大影响的决定进行人工审查，表达您的观点，并对决定提出异议。您可以联系我们申请对您的兼容度计算进行人工审查。
privacy.s7_profiling_withdraw: 您可以随时通过删除账户来撤回对用户画像的同意。请注意，兼容度评分是核心功能；禁用该功能将导致本应用无法按预期运行。
privacy.s8_text: 您的数据可能在您所在国家以外的国家处理。在需要时，我们依据标准合同条款或其他法律批准的传输机制来确保足够的保护水平。
privacy.s9_text: AstroDating 面向 18 岁及以上的用户。我们不会故意收集 18 岁以下人士的个人数据。如果我们发现某用户未满 18 岁，将立即删除其账户及相关数据。如果您认为有未成年人创建了账户，请立即与我们联系。
privacy.s10_text: 本应用可能包含指向第三方网站或服务的链接。本隐私政策不适用于这些服务，我们建议您独立查阅其隐私政策。
privacy.s11_text: 我们可能会不时更新本隐私政策。当我们做出重大变更时，将在变更生效前通过本应用或电子邮件通知您。本页面顶部的「最后更新」日期标明了政策最近一次修订的时间。在生效日期之后继续使用本应用即表示接受更新后的政策。
privacy.s12_text: 如果您对本隐私政策有疑问或希望行使您的数据权利，请通过以下方式联系我们：
privacy.s12_exercise_intro: 如需提交数据访问、删除、更正或可携带性请求：
privacy.s12_exercise1: 请发送邮件至 privacy@astrodatingapp.com 提出您的请求。
privacy.s12_exercise2: 我们将通过将您请求中的邮箱地址与注册账户进行比对来验证您的身份，如有必要，可能会要求提供额外信息。
privacy.s12_exercise3: 对于代表他人提出的请求，我们需要数据主体的书面授权和身份证明。
privacy.s12_timeline_gdpr: 欧洲经济区/英国（GDPR）：我们将在30天内回复。复杂请求可能会延长60天，届时会提前通知。
privacy.s12_timeline_ccpa: 加利福尼亚州（CCPA/CPRA）：我们将在45天内回复。复杂请求可能会延长45天，届时会提前通知。
privacy.s12_timeline_other: 其他管辖区：我们致力于在30天内回复。
privacy.s12_appeals: 如果您对我们的回复不满意，可以联系当地的数据保护机构或提出投诉。
privacy.s12_response: 我们致力于在 30 天内回复所有一般性咨询。

help.a_compatibility: 我们使用真实的合盘分析——一种比较两张星盘的占星实践。我们分析您和对方行星之间的相位（合相、三分相、四分相等），跨越关键的关系宫位来生成整体兼容度评分。
help.q_fewMatches: 为什么我看到的匹配对象不多？
help.a_fewMatches: 尝试扩大您的发现偏好：增加距离范围、扩大年龄范围，或降低最低兼容度阈值。您还可以移除特定的星座或元素筛选条件。
help.a_manageSub: 取决于您的订阅平台。在Android上，通过Google Play订阅设置管理。在网页上，前往设置 > 账单访问您的Stripe门户，可以更改或取消订阅。
help.a_refund: Google Play订阅的退款由Google根据其政策处理。网页（Stripe）订阅请通过联系表单联系我们的支持团队。我们会逐案审查退款请求。
help.q_autoRenew: 我的订阅会自动续订吗？
help.a_autoRenew: 是的。除非在当前周期结束前至少24小时取消，否则订阅将自动续订。您可以随时通过Google Play设置（Android）或网页应用的账单页面取消。
help.a_report: 点击任何资料页面或聊天对话中的三点菜单，然后选择「举报」。选择原因并添加详情。我们的团队会在 24 小时内审核所有举报。
help.a_block: 点击对方资料页面或聊天中的三点菜单，然后选择「屏蔽」。对方将无法查看您的资料或联系您，且不会收到通知。
help.q_locationShared: 我的位置信息会分享给其他用户吗？
help.a_locationShared: 仅显示您的大致距离（例如「3 英里以外」）。您的确切坐标永远不会对其他用户可见。
help.q_birthTime: 我需要知道确切的出生时间吗？
help.a_birthTime: 为了获得最准确的星盘，是的。您的出生时间决定了上升星座（命宫）和宫位分布，这些对兼容度评分有重大影响。如果您不知道确切时间，可以输入大致时间——但您的星盘和评分将不够精确。
help.q_sunVsFull: 太阳星座兼容度和全盘兼容度有什么区别？
help.a_sunVsFull: 太阳星座兼容度仅考虑一颗行星。全盘兼容度（合盘分析）分析两张星盘之间所有行星位置、相位和宫位叠合——提供更细致、更准确的关系动态全貌。
help.a_personalizedHoroscopes: 是的。与仅基于太阳星座的通用运势不同，我们的运势根据您的完整本命星盘计算，包括月亮、上升星座、金星和其他关键位置的行星过境。
help.a_promoCode: 在Android上，进入套餐页面并在选择套餐前输入促销代码。在网页上，在结账页面输入代码。促销代码根据活动提供折扣或额外月份。
help.a_webApp: 可以！访问app.astrodatingapp.com使用完整的网页应用。您可以浏览资料、聊天、查看星盘和管理订阅——全部在浏览器中完成。
help.q_installPwa: 可以在手机上安装网页应用吗？
help.a_installPwa: 可以。在手机浏览器中访问astrodatingapp.com，然后点击「添加到主屏幕」。应用将作为图标出现在主屏幕上，并以全屏模式打开。
help.q_webSync: 应用和网页之间的数据会同步吗？
help.a_webSync: 是的。您的资料、匹配、消息和订阅都会实时同步。您可以在移动应用和网页应用之间无缝切换。

safety.title: 安全与社区准则
safety.effectiveDate: 生效日期：2026年2月10日 — 最后更新：2026年2月10日
safety.intro: AstroDating 致力于为所有用户创造一个安全的环境。我们对儿童剥削、骚扰和虐待行为采取严格的政策。本页面概述了我们的安全标准和举报程序。
safety.s1_intro: AstroDating 严格限于18岁及以上的成年人使用。我们对任何剥削、危害或将未成年人性化的内容或行为采取零容忍态度。
safety.s1_zeroTolerance: 零容忍：任何违反我们儿童安全政策的行为将导致账户立即终止并向执法部门举报。
safety.s1_csam: 儿童性虐待材料（CSAM）被严格禁止，将被举报给NCMEC和执法部门。
safety.s1_exploitation: 任何描述、宣传或助长儿童剥削的内容均被禁止。
safety.s1_minors: 18岁以下的用户不得使用本平台。
safety.s1_grooming: 任何试图联系、引诱或诱导未成年人的行为将导致永久封禁并通知执法部门。
safety.s2_intro: 我们采取多项措施确保所有用户均为成年人：
safety.s2_age18: 所有用户必须在注册时确认年满18岁。
safety.s2_verification: 我们可能随时要求进行额外的年龄验证。
safety.s2_termination: 疑似属于未成年人的账户将被立即暂停，等待验证。
safety.s3_intro: 我们采用全面的安全措施来保护我们的社区：
safety.s3_ageVerification: 账户注册时进行年龄验证
safety.s3_reporting: 应用内举报系统，用于举报不当内容和行为
safety.s3_moderation: 全天候内容审核和被举报内容审查
safety.s3_termination: 违反政策立即终止账户
safety.s3_ncmec: 与NCMEC（美国失踪与被剥削儿童中心）合作举报非法内容
safety.s4_intro: 如果您发现任何令人担忧的内容或行为，请立即举报：
safety.s4_inApp: 使用应用内举报功能（点击任何个人资料或聊天中的三点菜单）
safety.s4_email: 如有紧急问题，请直接发送电子邮件给我们的安全团队
safety.s5_intro: 所有用户必须遵守我们的社区准则：
safety.s5_authentic: 仅使用您自己的照片并提供准确的信息
safety.s5_noHarassment: 禁止骚扰、欺凌或威胁行为
safety.s5_noHate: 禁止仇恨言论、歧视或冒犯性内容
safety.s5_noScams: 禁止诈骗、垃圾信息或索取金钱
safety.s5_noExplicit: 禁止在公开个人资料中发布露骨或色情内容
safety.s6_intro: AstroDating 遵守所有关于儿童保护和网络安全的适用法律：
safety.s6_laws: 我们遵守COPPA、CSAM举报要求和国际儿童保护法律。
safety.s6_ncmec: 我们按照法律要求向NCMEC的CyberTipline举报所有发现的CSAM。
safety.s6_cooperation: 我们全面配合执法部门关于儿童安全的调查。
safety.s7_text: 如有安全问题或举报违规行为，请联系我们专门的安全团队：
safety.s7_response: 我们优先处理安全举报，并努力在24小时内回复。涉及儿童安全的紧急事项将立即处理。

webApp.dailyHoroscopeLensV2_aries: Today asks Aries to use that quickness on purpose. Move fast where it matters, slow down where someone needs to be heard. The fire is real — it lands better with a moment of patience attached.
webApp.dailyHoroscopeLensV2_taurus: Today asks Taurus to trust the slower pace. The things worth building rarely come fast, and the body usually knows when to pause. Choose what feels solid over what feels exciting, even if only for the next hour.
webApp.dailyHoroscopeLensV2_gemini: Today asks Gemini to pick one thread and stay on it for a while. Curiosity is a gift, but depth is where the conversation actually changes. One real exchange may beat ten brief ones.
webApp.dailyHoroscopeLensV2_cancer: Today asks Cancer to mind the inner weather. Mood tends to lead here, and that's fine — but check whose mood you're carrying. Some of what feels heavy may belong to someone else.
webApp.dailyHoroscopeLensV2_leo: Today asks Leo to give warmth without needing a return. Generosity reads strongest when it isn't watching for applause. The shine you don't notice is often the one people remember.
webApp.dailyHoroscopeLensV2_virgo: Today asks Virgo to let one thing be imperfect. Precision is a real strength here, but it can quietly turn into a self-tax. Done is sometimes more useful than refined.
webApp.dailyHoroscopeLensV2_libra: Today asks Libra to choose, even slightly. Balance is the gift, but balance held too long becomes stalling. Picking a side gently is still picking.
webApp.dailyHoroscopeLensV2_scorpio: Today asks Scorpio to say the quiet thing. The depth is already there — putting it into words is the harder part. Honest beats hidden today, even if honest is uncomfortable.
webApp.dailyHoroscopeLensV2_sagittarius: Today asks Sagittarius to land a little. The horizon is calling, fine — but the people in front of you may need full presence first. Travel can wait until after the conversation.
webApp.dailyHoroscopeLensV2_capricorn: Today asks Capricorn to let competence rest for a moment. The plan can hold without your full grip on it. The world will not collapse if you take a slow evening.
webApp.dailyHoroscopeLensV2_aquarius: Today asks Aquarius to come a little closer in. Independence stays intact — closeness doesn't cancel it. Let someone see the part that doesn't usually get shown.
webApp.dailyHoroscopeLensV2_pisces: Today asks Pisces to stay in your own water. Empathy is real here, but it can absorb. Notice where your feelings end and someone else's begin.
webApp.dailyHoroscopeDatingLensV2_aries: If you're dating today, the honest version of yourself reads better than the smooth one — Aries shines when it doesn't rehearse.
webApp.dailyHoroscopeDatingLensV2_taurus: If you're dating today, lean into the steady — a slow, present hour with someone may carry more than three quick ones.
webApp.dailyHoroscopeDatingLensV2_gemini: If you're dating today, let the conversation breathe — silence between two curious people is still part of the date.
webApp.dailyHoroscopeDatingLensV2_cancer: If you're dating today, the small care moves first — a check-in text may land deeper than a grand gesture.
webApp.dailyHoroscopeDatingLensV2_leo: If you're dating today, let yourself be chosen, not just chosen back — receiving attention is also part of the offer.
webApp.dailyHoroscopeDatingLensV2_virgo: If you're dating today, drop the mental edit — the message you almost sent is usually the one that lands.
webApp.dailyHoroscopeDatingLensV2_libra: If you're dating today, choose a real preference out loud — keeping things easy for the other person can quietly become invisible.
webApp.dailyHoroscopeDatingLensV2_scorpio: If you're dating today, say the layer underneath — Scorpio reads as too intense when it hides, not when it shows.
webApp.dailyHoroscopeDatingLensV2_sagittarius: If you're dating today, let the freedom be visible — but stay through the slower part of the conversation.
webApp.dailyHoroscopeDatingLensV2_capricorn: If you're dating today, soften the structure a notch — keeping your word matters, but spontaneity is allowed too.
webApp.dailyHoroscopeDatingLensV2_aquarius: If you're dating today, let warmth in alongside the independence — distance can be a habit, not a need.
webApp.dailyHoroscopeDatingLensV2_pisces: If you're dating today, name what you feel before you absorb what they feel — your impressions count first.

webApp.natalChartDisclaimerBody: Read each placement as one piece of the whole chart. Astrology works best as a pattern language, not a fixed label.
webApp.natalPlanetMeaning_sun: The Sun describes your core identity, direction, and the energy you naturally radiate.
webApp.natalPlanetMeaning_moon: The Moon describes your emotional rhythm — what soothes you, what triggers you, what you need to feel safe.
webApp.natalPlanetMeaning_rising: The Rising describes how you arrive in a room — first impressions, visible style, the way you enter new situations.
webApp.natalPlanetMeaning_mercury: Mercury describes how you think, speak, and process information.
webApp.natalPlanetMeaning_venus: Venus describes how you love, attract, and what feels like care to you.
webApp.natalPlanetMeaning_mars: Mars describes how you go after what you want — drive, anger, desire, momentum.
webApp.natalPlanetMeaning_jupiter: Jupiter describes how you expand, learn, find meaning, and look for the bigger picture.
webApp.natalPlanetMeaning_saturn: Saturn describes where you build structure, take responsibility, and where things tend to take time.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_mercury_aries: In Aries, it can show a direct, fast-moving communication style — quick to initiate, honest, and sometimes impatient with long preambles. Decisions land fast; small talk feels like friction.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_venus_taurus: In Taurus, Venus can prefer slow, sensual, reliable affection. Gestures matter more than declarations. Comfort and consistency may feel like the truest signs of love.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_moon_cancer: In Cancer, the Moon is at home. Emotions can run deep, memory holds tight, and the urge to nurture (or be nurtured) is strong. Mood may track the people you love more than the weather.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_mars_leo: In Leo, Mars can act with confidence, warmth, and a flair for the dramatic. Effort tends to be visible. May fight for what feels personal more than for what is strictly useful.
webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_mercury_aries: May prefer clear, bold messages over vague hints. Tends to tell the truth fast — sometimes faster than the other person is ready for. Likes a partner who answers directly and doesn't punish the speed.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_mercury_taurus: In Taurus, Mercury can slow the mind down on purpose — deliberate, sensory, careful with words. Conclusions tend to form once they feel earned, not because someone asked for them fast. May resist being rushed.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_mercury_gemini: In Gemini, the mind tends to move fast and wide — many tabs open at once, curiosity as the default setting. Conversation can feel like its own pleasure. Decisions may benefit from a second pass after the first burst.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_mercury_cancer: In Cancer, thinking can travel through feeling first. Memory holds tightly, especially around tone. May read between lines well, sometimes too well — assuming meaning that wasn't intended.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_venus_aries: In Aries, Venus tends to go after attraction the way it wants to be wanted: directly. May initiate, lose interest if pursuit becomes too easy, and re-engage on a spark. Often honest about preferences before the other person is ready to hear them.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_venus_gemini: In Gemini, Venus can love through words — banter, curiosity, the buzz of a good back-and-forth. Variety may feel like care; sameness may feel like settling. Attention can shift quickly between connections.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_venus_cancer: In Cancer, Venus loves through care — feeding, remembering, holding space. May test for safety before fully showing up, then go all in once the read feels solid.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_mars_aries: In Aries, Mars is at home — fast off the line, direct about wanting, allergic to passivity. Anger may rise quickly and pass quickly too. Action tends to come before deliberation.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_mars_taurus: In Taurus, Mars conserves energy. Slow to start, hard to stop. Effort tends to be steady and physical. Desire is often more practical than dramatic — what feels good, what holds up over time.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_mars_cancer: In Cancer, Mars can go after what it wants sideways. Direct confrontation may feel risky; protecting loved ones may feel non-negotiable. Anger can swallow itself, then resurface as mood.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_moon_aries: In Aries, the Moon feels things fast and clean. Emotions can land like weather — intense, then gone. May surprise people with how openly the heat shows, then move on while others are still digesting.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_moon_taurus: In Taurus, the Moon settles into the body. Calm tends to come from food, touch, a familiar room, a steady rhythm. Stability can feel less like a preference and more like a need. Change may unsettle even when it's wanted.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_moon_leo: In Leo, the Moon may need to be seen to feel safe. Validation isn't ego here, it's reassurance. Generosity can be huge; drama may rise when affection feels withheld, and pride can make asking for closeness hard.
webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_venus_taurus: Likely to be loyal once settled, and resistant to drama. May take time to open, but rarely halfway.
webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_venus_aries: Excitement may matter more than security here. Likely to bring energy and play; can need to learn that some loves grow slowly without dying.
webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_venus_gemini: Likely to fall in love through conversation first. Wants someone who keeps the chat alive. Boredom is a real risk; deep silence may be harder than novelty.
webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_venus_cancer: Vulnerability is often the love language here. Closeness can feel like being known, not just liked. Past hurts may linger; patience tends to read as proof.
webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_mars_leo: Pursuit can be open and proud. Wants to be wanted out loud — small private affection alone may not feel like enough.
webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_mars_aries: Pursuit can be passionate but impatient. More likely to chase than to wait. May appreciate a partner who matches the pace rather than tries to slow it.
webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_mars_taurus: Pursuit tends to be patient and grounded. Likely to want a partner who is present in body, not just in promises. Stubbornness can be loyalty's shadow side.
webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_mars_cancer: More likely to fight for the bond than for the spotlight. Wants partners who feel emotionally safe to argue with. Withdrawal can be a defense; words tend to help.
webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_moon_cancer: Closeness can feel like oxygen here. Wants to be remembered, fed, taken care of — and gives those things back generously.
webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_moon_aries: Closeness can feel like permission to be honest, even when it's spiky. May need partners who don't punish quickness or read silence as ending; the mood tends to rotate.

webApp.natalPlanetInHouse_mars_11: Mars in the 11th house can put drive into groups, causes, and the future. Often a mobilizer. May fight for the team more than for self.
webApp.natalPlanetInHouse_mars_12: Mars in the 12th house can carry drive underground. Anger may be private, sometimes turned inward. The most powerful action may happen alone, in art, or in service.
webApp.natalPlanetInHouse_jupiter_1: Jupiter in the 1st house can make optimism part of the surface. Often known for confidence, warmth, and big presence. May benefit from learning when to dial it back.
webApp.natalPlanetInHouse_jupiter_2: Jupiter in the 2nd house can expand around resources, comfort, and self-worth. Often lucky with money over time. Generosity may be a core value.
webApp.natalPlanetInHouse_jupiter_3: Jupiter in the 3rd house can expand thinking and voice. Often well-read, well-traveled in idea-form, and drawn to teaching or writing.
webApp.natalPlanetInHouse_jupiter_4: Jupiter in the 4th house can bring abundance through home, family, and roots. May host generously. Inner life tends to be a quiet source of strength.
webApp.natalPlanetInHouse_jupiter_5: Jupiter in the 5th house can expand creativity, romance, and play. Often lucky in love and self-expression. Risk-taking may pay off here more than expected.
webApp.natalPlanetInHouse_jupiter_6: Jupiter in the 6th house can grow through work and service. Often well-positioned in careers, and known for being useful. May need to watch overcommitting to others' problems.
webApp.natalPlanetInHouse_jupiter_7: Jupiter in the 7th house can grow through partnership. Often draws generous, expansive partners. Marriage and business alliances may be where the most growth happens.
webApp.natalPlanetInHouse_jupiter_8: Jupiter in the 8th house can grow through depth, intimacy, and shared resources. May be a strong placement for investments, therapy, and serious transformation.
webApp.natalPlanetInHouse_jupiter_9: Jupiter in the 9th house — its natural home. Tends to grow through travel, philosophy, faith, and the bigger view. Optimism often runs strong.
webApp.natalPlanetInHouse_jupiter_10: Jupiter in the 10th house can grow career, reputation, and public role. May rise to visible positions. Generosity at work may be part of the brand.
webApp.natalPlanetInHouse_jupiter_11: Jupiter in the 11th house can grow through community, friendship, and future-building. Often lucky in groups and visible online. Long-term vision tends to be wide.
webApp.natalPlanetInHouse_jupiter_12: Jupiter in the 12th house can grow through the inner life — solitude, art, faith, service. Spiritual practice may carry real weight here.
webApp.natalPlanetInHouse_saturn_1: Saturn in the 1st house can give presence weight. Often feels older than the years, takes self-presentation seriously, and may need to learn to lighten up over time.
webApp.natalPlanetInHouse_saturn_2: Saturn in the 2nd house can ask hard questions about money and worth. Security tends to be earned slowly. May need to learn that worth isn't only what you can show.
webApp.natalPlanetInHouse_saturn_3: Saturn in the 3rd house can make thinking and speaking feel heavy. May be careful with words, slow to claim opinions, and a serious learner. Voice tends to mature with use.
webApp.natalPlanetInHouse_saturn_4: Saturn in the 4th house can put real work into home and family. May carry the responsible role from early on. Building a soft inner home may be the long assignment.
webApp.natalPlanetInHouse_saturn_5: Saturn in the 5th house can make creativity, romance, and play feel like work. Often slower to relax, slower to date. Joy tends to be earned, then keeps better.
webApp.natalPlanetInHouse_saturn_6: Saturn in the 6th house can be exacting about work, routine, and health. Often disciplined, sometimes too hard on the body. Sustainable systems tend to be the win.
webApp.natalPlanetInHouse_saturn_7: Saturn in the 7th house can take partnership seriously. Tends to want real, committed relationships — and may take longer to find them. Boundaries become a real skill.
webApp.natalPlanetInHouse_saturn_8: Saturn in the 8th house can put long, careful work into intimacy, shared resources, and transformation. May guard the deeper life carefully. Trust tends to mature slowly.
webApp.natalPlanetInHouse_saturn_9: Saturn in the 9th house can make belief, study, or travel feel like a long project. Faith tends to be tested. May become an authority in a chosen field — eventually.
webApp.natalPlanetInHouse_saturn_10: Saturn in the 10th house — at home. Career may be the long, real game. Public role tends to mature with time; authority may be earned the hard way and held cleanly.
webApp.natalPlanetInHouse_saturn_11: Saturn in the 11th house can be selective about community. Friend groups may turn over before settling. Long-term vision tends to be serious.
webApp.natalPlanetInHouse_saturn_12: Saturn in the 12th house can make the inner life its own workshop. Often a private commitment to discipline, healing, or solo practice. Burnout may be the watch-out.

webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_sun_taurus: In dating, this Sun may value consistency over intensity. Grand promises matter less than someone who shows up, keeps their word, and makes love feel calm enough to trust.

webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_sun_sagittarius: In dating, this Sun may want freedom inside the love. Wants partners who travel well, argue with humor, and don't read independence as a problem.
webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_sun_capricorn: In dating, this Sun may want long arcs over fast sparks. Wants partners who keep their word, show up over years, and don't punish ambition.

webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_sun_pisces: In dating, this Sun may love with imagination. Wants partners who can feel things back, who don't laugh at the soft stuff, and who help keep the dreams from drifting too far.

webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_moon_aquarius: Closeness can need space inside it. Wants partners who befriend before they cling, and who don't take independence personally.
webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_moon_pisces: Closeness can feel like being deeply felt. Wants partners who handle moods gently, who don't trample dreams, and who get that solitude is care, not rejection.

webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_rising_taurus: Often comes across calm and physical in dating. Partners may need to like the slower pace; fast escalation may not feel like attraction here.

webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_rising_leo: Often comes across magnetic and confident in dating. Partners may need to enjoy being chosen out loud, not just behind closed doors.
webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_rising_virgo: Often comes across composed in dating. Partners may need to not push past observation too fast — first impressions take a careful read.
webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_rising_libra: Often comes across charming and balanced in dating. Partners may need to break through politeness to find the real thing underneath.
webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_rising_scorpio: Often comes across intense and a little mysterious in dating. Partners may need to handle the test — closeness here is earned, not assumed.
webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_rising_sagittarius: Often comes across open and adventurous in dating. Partners may need to like motion — restless can read as charming, but it's still restless.
webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_rising_capricorn: Often comes across grown and reserved in dating. Partners may need to not mistake seriousness for distance; warmth shows up later, but it shows up real.

webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_rising_pisces: Often comes across soft and emotionally open in dating. Partners may need to be careful with this surface — it picks things up quickly.

webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_mercury_gemini: May text constantly, in many threads, with jokes layered. Wants partners who can banter back and don't read tonal shifts as moods.
webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_mercury_cancer: May read tone before content. Wants partners who choose words carefully when it matters — and who notice when something lands wrong.
webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_mercury_leo: May tell stories well and like an audience. Wants partners who can listen, react, and not steal the punchline.

webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_mercury_scorpio: May ask the real question early. Wants partners who don't deflect, and who let truth be more important than image.
webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_mercury_sagittariu: May say things plainly, sometimes too plainly. Wants partners who can take honesty without flinching, and who don't punish blunt.
webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_mercury_capricorn: May talk less but mean more. Wants partners who don't fill silence anxiously, and who treat promises as load-bearing.
webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_mercury_aquarius: May think out loud about ideas, the future, the system. Wants partners who can engage the brain, not just the romance.
webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_mercury_pisces: May speak in images and feel-words. Wants partners who can read between lines without making it a guessing game.
webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_venus_leo: Love may need to be public, generous, and clearly named. Wants partners who don't hide the relationship, who give warmth out loud, and who take pride in being chosen back.
webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_venus_virgo: Love may show up through small, useful acts — and need to be received as love, not just chores. Wants partners who notice the gestures and don't ask for grand performance.
webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_venus_libra: Love may feel best when it's fair, mutual, and beautiful. Wants partners who match the effort, dress for the date, and don't let things slide quietly into routine.
webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_venus_scorpio: Love may need depth, privacy, and full presence. Wants partners who can keep the intimate things intimate, and who don't treat trust casually.
webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_venus_sagittarius: Love may need travel, plans, and shared belief. Wants partners who can keep up with the next idea, and who don't shrink the world.
webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_venus_capricorn: Love may be tested before trusted, and last when others fade. Wants partners who play long, keep their word, and don't punish ambition.
webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_venus_aquarius: Love may need space inside it. Wants partners who are friends first, who don't read distance as rejection, and who keep their own life alive.
webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_venus_pisces: Love may be devotional and dreamy. Wants partners who can hold the soft parts gently — and may need to learn to choose people who actually show up.

webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_mars_virgo: Pursuit may be careful and quietly persistent. Wants partners who notice the small efforts and don't mistake precision for lack of heat.
webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_mars_libra: Pursuit may charm rather than push. Wants partners who can handle indirect heat — and who don't punish polite first moves.
webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_mars_scorpio: Pursuit may be slow, focused, and intense. Wants partners who can handle being wanted fully — and who don't ghost when things get serious.

webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_jupiter_aries: May fall in love fast and big. Wants partners who can match the energy and don't punish enthusiasm.

webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_jupiter_gemini: May love through conversation that goes everywhere. Wants partners who keep the curiosity live.

webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_jupiter_leo: May love through warmth, generosity, and the big gesture. Wants partners who shine alongside, not in the shadow.
webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_jupiter_virgo: May love through being useful in real life. Wants partners who can take help, not just give it.

webApp.natalChartFeaturedInsightsBody: A closer read on a few of your placements. We're adding more interpretations every release.
webApp.natalChartHousesBody: Each house describes a life area. The sign sitting on each house cusp colors how that area unfolds — which is why two charts with the same Sun sign can still feel very different.
webApp.natalHouseMeaning_1: Identity, body, how you start things, the way you arrive in a room.
webApp.natalHouseMeaning_2: Money, possessions, values, what feels safe and earned.
webApp.natalHouseMeaning_3: Communication, siblings, daily learning, your immediate world.
webApp.natalHouseMeaning_4: Home, family, roots, emotional foundation, private life.
webApp.natalHouseMeaning_6: Daily routine, work, health, the small habits that compound.
webApp.natalHouseMeaning_7: One-on-one partnerships, mirrors, the people you sign on with.
webApp.natalHouseMeaning_8: Shared resources, intimacy, transformation, what's hidden but real.
webApp.natalHouseMeaning_9: Travel, philosophy, higher learning, the search for meaning.
webApp.natalHouseMeaning_10: Career, public image, achievement, your visible role in the world.
webApp.natalHouseMeaning_11: Friends, groups, long-term hopes, the future you're building toward.
webApp.natalHouseMeaning_12: Solitude, dreams, what's behind the curtain, surrender.

webApp.synastryScoreBody_exceptional: This score suggests an unusually easy overlap between core needs, attraction, and communication. Treat it as an invitation to go deeper — not as a guarantee.
webApp.synastryScoreBody_strong: There is a clear sense of mutual rhythm here. The connection may feel easier to read, with enough shared language to support deeper conversations.
webApp.synastryScoreBody_promising: This score points to real overlap, with a few areas that may need curiosity instead of assumption. Start with what feels easy, then ask about what feels different.
webApp.synastryScoreBody_mixed: There is meaningful potential here, but the charts may move at different speeds. This kind of dynamic benefits from clear communication and slower assumptions.
webApp.synastryScoreBody_growth: This score suggests the connection may ask for more patience, translation, and emotional clarity. It can still be valuable if both people stay curious.
webApp.synastryScoreBody_different: Your charts may approach closeness, timing, or communication differently. Treat the score as a prompt to ask better questions, not as a reason to dismiss someone.

webApp.synastryV2WhyBody: Three element pairings shape the overall rhythm — they're a starting point, not a verdict.
webApp.synastryV2FactorBody_elementRhythm: How your core energies move together — what tempo feels natural between you.
webApp.synastryV2FactorBody_emotionalPace: How you both settle into closeness — and how each of you signals safety.
webApp.synastryV2FactorBody_risingRhythm: How you first read each other — the surface tempo before the deeper layers.
webApp.synastryV2DimensionBody_emotional: How easily you can both name what's underneath, and let it land.
webApp.synastryV2DimensionBody_communication: How your minds meet — pace, curiosity, and the kind of questions that feel easy.
webApp.synastryV2DimensionBody_attraction: How each of you expresses interest and receives it back.
webApp.synastryV2DimensionBody_stability: How you both hold steady when the early sparks settle into something real.
webApp.synastryV2Cue_emotional: Ask what they need when things feel heavy — and what helps it lift.
webApp.synastryV2Cue_communication: Notice whether they answer fast or sit with a question. Match the tempo.
webApp.synastryV2Cue_attraction: Pay attention to how they show care — not just how they ask for it.
webApp.synastryV2Cue_stability: Talk about the unglamorous stuff early — routines, rest, the small commitments.

webApp.synastryV2TalkBody: Three lenses, grounded in their chart — start with whichever feels closest to how you already connect.
webApp.synastryV2Prompt_mercury_fire: Ask a direct question and leave room for a fast, honest answer.
webApp.synastryV2Prompt_mercury_earth: Ground the conversation in something concrete: routines, values, plans.
webApp.synastryV2Prompt_mercury_air: Start with curiosity. A good tangent may tell you more than a perfect question.
webApp.synastryV2Prompt_mercury_water: Ask gently and listen for tone, not just words.
webApp.synastryV2Prompt_moon_fire: Name what you actually feel out loud — they read directness as care.
webApp.synastryV2Prompt_moon_earth: Comfort lives in small, reliable gestures. Show up consistently, not loudly.
webApp.synastryV2Prompt_moon_air: Give them space to talk things through. Listening is the safety they're looking for.
webApp.synastryV2Prompt_moon_water: Slow down. Their emotional weather changes; don't try to fix it, just notice it with them.
webApp.synastryV2Prompt_venus_fire: Show interest with energy and play. Subtle hints get missed.
webApp.synastryV2Prompt_venus_earth: Small, real gestures land harder than grand ones. Plan something simple, not staged.
webApp.synastryV2Prompt_venus_air: Connect through ideas first. Affection follows when their mind feels alive.
webApp.synastryV2Prompt_venus_water: Care quietly. They notice the things most people overlook.

webApp.luckyDaysV2Subtitle: A symbolic monthly rhythm for reflection, connection, and intention.
webApp.luckyDaysV2LensConnectBody: This month is a good frame for connection. Reach out without an agenda, hold the conversation a beat longer than usual, and let someone in slightly more than your default. Connection isn't a transaction; it's a rhythm.
webApp.luckyDaysV2LensReflectBody: Use this month to notice patterns rather than just react to events. The same situation showing up twice is data; three times is a pattern. Journal, talk to a real friend, or sit quietly long enough to hear yourself.
webApp.luckyDaysV2LensResetBody: This month carries room for a soft reset — a routine swapped, a habit retired, a small piece of life put back in order. Don't aim for transformation; aim for one thing that's slightly less heavy by month's end.
webApp.luckyDaysV2LensPlanBody: Use this month to plan in months, not days. What do the next 90 days want from you? Where do you need to be by then? Plan in arcs and intentions, not in to-do items.
webApp.luckyDaysV2DisclaimerBody: These are planning windows for reflection, not lucky dates. Astrology works best as a pattern language, not a guarantee.

webApp.luckyDaysThemeV2_aries: Initiate, push, then learn to land
webApp.luckyDaysThemeV2_gemini: Gather threads, pick the one worth pulling
webApp.luckyDaysThemeV2_leo: Show up warm, give from full
webApp.luckyDaysThemeV2_sagittarius: Move with belief, return with insight
webApp.luckyDaysThemeV2_aquarius: Step out of the script, then step back in
webApp.luckyDaysEarlyWindowV2_aries: Use the early days for one bold first move. Start before second-guessing. Direction matters more than timing.
webApp.luckyDaysEarlyWindowV2_taurus: Use the early days to set a slow, sustainable pace. Choose what's worth your full month, not just your full week.
webApp.luckyDaysEarlyWindowV2_gemini: Use the early days to open a few threads — but mark which one is the real one. The rest are scenery.
webApp.luckyDaysEarlyWindowV2_cancer: Use the early days to set the emotional temperature. What you protect now tends to hold for the month.
webApp.luckyDaysEarlyWindowV2_leo: Use the early days to say something out loud — a creative claim, a feeling, a yes. Visibility builds momentum here.
webApp.luckyDaysEarlyWindowV2_virgo: Use the early days to clear what's been dragging. A tidied inbox, a finished task. Small order begets bigger order.
webApp.luckyDaysEarlyWindowV2_libra: Use the early days to choose, even slightly. Decisions made now don't have to be perfect — they just have to be made.
webApp.luckyDaysEarlyWindowV2_scorpio: Use the early days to identify the real thing you're tracking this month. The surface story is usually not it.
webApp.luckyDaysEarlyWindowV2_sagittarius: Use the early days to set the bigger frame. What does this month belong to? Name it before momentum picks up.
webApp.luckyDaysEarlyWindowV2_capricorn: Use the early days to plant the structural piece. The thing that holds the rest of the month together.
webApp.luckyDaysEarlyWindowV2_aquarius: Use the early days for a slightly different angle. A new lens, a different room, a friend you haven't called.
webApp.luckyDaysEarlyWindowV2_pisces: Use the early days to listen for the month's feeling. What does it want from you? Don't push past the first impression.
webApp.luckyDaysMidWindowV2_aries: Mid-month asks for follow-through. The fire from week one needs structure now, not more fuel.
webApp.luckyDaysMidWindowV2_taurus: Mid-month is your home turf — steady, productive, sensory. Let this stretch carry most of your real work.

webApp.dateReflectionV2IntentBody: Pick one. The rest of this page adjusts to the kind of moment you're preparing for.
webApp.dateReflectionV2Lens_firstConversation: First conversations work best when you stay genuinely curious. Notice how they describe their day, the small things that make them laugh, the way they ask questions back. You're not auditioning each other — you're listening for whether there's something real to keep exploring.
webApp.dateReflectionV2Lens_firstDate: A first date is mostly about presence. Pay attention to the energy between sentences, not just the words. Does the conversation feel easy or effortful? Are you both relaxing as the time passes, or trying harder? Those signals tell you more than any clever question.
webApp.dateReflectionV2Lens_reconnect: Reconnecting asks for honesty about what changed. Notice what they bring up first — and what they avoid. The goal isn't to pick up exactly where things left off; it's to meet who each of you has become since.
webApp.dateReflectionV2Lens_deepen: Deepening a bond happens slowly. Pay attention to the moments they share something a little more vulnerable, and to how you respond. Slowing down, asking a real follow-up, choosing curiosity over reassurance — those are the moves that actually deepen things.
webApp.dateReflectionV2Avoid_firstConversation: Don't try to make the first conversation prove anything. You don't have to be clever, charming, or memorable on demand. Forcing chemistry into a chat thread almost always reads as effortful — and the right person won't need you to perform.
webApp.dateReflectionV2Avoid_firstDate: Resist the urge to lock in a verdict by the end of the date. First dates are usually quieter than the stories we tell about them. Let it be incomplete. You don't have to know if you're "in" yet — you just have to know if you'd like to keep talking.
webApp.dateReflectionV2Avoid_reconnect: Don't pretend the gap didn't happen. Skipping past it to recreate the old version of the connection rarely works. Acknowledge that things shifted, even briefly, and let the new version of the conversation breathe.
webApp.dateReflectionV2Avoid_deepen: Don't push for closeness on a timeline. Deepening isn't a milestone you hit by saying the right serious thing — it's the byproduct of consistent, honest, unhurried attention. If it feels forced, it probably is.

webApp.dateReflectionV2Prompts_firstDate_1: What makes a conversation feel easy for you?
webApp.dateReflectionV2Prompts_firstDate_2: What's something small you've been enjoying lately that you wouldn't normally mention?
webApp.dateReflectionV2Prompts_firstDate_3: When do you feel most at home in your own life?
webApp.dateReflectionV2Prompts_reconnect_1: What's different for you now compared to the last time we talked properly?
webApp.dateReflectionV2Prompts_reconnect_2: What did you actually want from our last chapter, looking back?
webApp.dateReflectionV2Prompts_reconnect_3: What would feel honest to name between us before we keep going?
webApp.dateReflectionV2Prompts_deepen_1: What's something you've been thinking about but haven't said out loud yet?
webApp.dateReflectionV2Prompts_deepen_2: When do you feel closest to me — and when do you feel further away?
webApp.dateReflectionV2Prompts_deepen_3: What does care look like for you, in the small everyday ways?
webApp.dateReflectionV2Idea_firstConversation_1: Send a short voice note before you meet — your voice carries warmth that text strips out.
webApp.dateReflectionV2Idea_firstConversation_2: Trade a song or a podcast you've actually been listening to this week.
webApp.dateReflectionV2Idea_firstConversation_3: Ask one open question and let your reply be longer than a sentence. Set the pace.
webApp.dateReflectionV2Idea_firstDate_1: A walk and a coffee. Movement keeps silences from feeling heavy, and you can extend or end it naturally.
webApp.dateReflectionV2Idea_firstDate_2: A quiet drink at a low-key spot. Bonus points if the place doesn't require shouting.
webApp.dateReflectionV2Idea_firstDate_3: A small bookstore or a tiny gallery — something to react to together so the conversation doesn't have to carry every minute.
webApp.dateReflectionV2Idea_reconnect_1: A simple lunch instead of a candlelit dinner. Lower the stakes; let the conversation set the temperature.
webApp.dateReflectionV2Idea_reconnect_2: A long walk in a familiar place. Familiar settings make honest conversations easier.
webApp.dateReflectionV2Idea_reconnect_3: A shared playlist before you meet. It gives you something to listen for in each other again.
webApp.dateReflectionV2Idea_deepen_1: Cook one part of a meal together. Doing something with your hands invites the slower kind of talking.
webApp.dateReflectionV2Idea_deepen_2: A no-phones evening. One agreed hour where you're both fully here.
webApp.dateReflectionV2Idea_deepen_3: Share one thing each that's felt heavy this week, with no fix expected. Just witness it.
webApp.dateReflectionV2BoundariesBody: A good date still needs consent, curiosity, and room for both people to change their mind. None of these prompts or ideas are a script — read the moment you're in, and let either of you stop or shift the plan without explaining.
webApp.dateReflectionV2DisclaimerBody: Use this as a reflection tool, not a prediction. The best timing is still the one both people choose freely.

webApp.monthlyHoroscopeLensV2_aries: Across this month Aries tends to feel the engine before the destination — there's energy looking for something real to commit to. The pattern often rewards picking one direction and staying with it past the first dip in motivation. Speed is not the gift here; chosen speed is. Where you keep starting and dropping, the month asks for one project, one person, one promise that you actually finish.
webApp.monthlyHoroscopeLensV2_taurus: This month tends to move Taurus in slow circles — building, settling, refining, settling deeper. The rhythm rewards staying with what's already in your hands rather than chasing the next thing. Comfort isn't laziness here; it's information about what your body can sustain. The pattern often quietly asks: what do you keep, and what have you been holding only out of habit?
webApp.monthlyHoroscopeLensV2_gemini: Gemini's month often opens with many possible doors — conversations, half-projects, ideas that want air. The shape of the month tends to favor closing some of them on purpose so the remaining ones can deepen. Variety stays a strength; scattered isn't the same as curious. The pattern asks where breadth has quietly become a way of not committing.
webApp.monthlyHoroscopeLensV2_cancer: This month tends to move Cancer toward the people, places, and rituals that genuinely feel like home. The arc often favors building inward before reaching outward — sleep, kitchen, close circle, slow conversation. Sensitivity is a tool here, not a leak. The pattern asks who in your life gets your softest version, and whether you're giving it where it actually nourishes you back.
webApp.monthlyHoroscopeLensV2_leo: Leo's month often runs warmer than usual — there's a pull to be seen, to make, to gather people. The pattern tends to land best when generosity is the leading note and applause is just the echo. Recognition matters; it just doesn't need to be earned twice. The arc asks where you're performing warmth versus where you're simply being warm.
webApp.monthlyHoroscopeLensV2_virgo: Virgo's month tends to favor careful editing over big new launches — the systems already in motion want refining, not replacing. Precision is the gift; perfectionism is the tax. The pattern often rewards finishing the unfinished rather than designing the next plan. Where you've been polishing the same thing for weeks, the month asks if it's already done.
webApp.monthlyHoroscopeLensV2_libra: Libra's month often holds a quiet choice underneath the easy days — something you've been keeping balanced may want a small decision. The pattern rewards picking gently and on time rather than waiting for the option that costs nothing. Diplomacy stays a real strength; deferral is its shadow. The arc asks which 'maybe' has quietly become a 'no.'
webApp.monthlyHoroscopeLensV2_scorpio: This month tends to move Scorpio toward what's been simmering beneath the surface — a feeling, a truth, a closeness that's been waiting. The pattern often rewards saying the layer underneath rather than guarding it. Depth lands here; depth withheld tends to pressurize. The arc asks where honesty would loosen the room you're in.
webApp.monthlyHoroscopeLensV2_sagittarius: Sagittarius's month often reaches wide — for travel, ideas, the bigger frame. The rhythm rewards balancing that reach with staying long enough to see something through with the people in front of you. Freedom isn't threatened by presence. The pattern asks which horizon you're chasing to avoid the closer one.
webApp.monthlyHoroscopeLensV2_capricorn: Capricorn's month tends to favor patient building over visible proof — the work that compounds quietly may matter more than the milestone everyone sees. The pattern rewards trusting the long arc and resting inside it. Competence stays a real currency; over-functioning isn't the same as commitment. The arc asks what you're carrying that someone else could.
webApp.monthlyHoroscopeLensV2_aquarius: Aquarius's month often invites a small step toward people, not away — independence stays intact, and closeness doesn't undo it. The pattern rewards letting someone see the part of you that doesn't usually get shown. Originality is a real gift; distance can quietly become a habit dressed as identity. The arc asks where you'd rather be a little closer.
webApp.monthlyHoroscopeLensV2_pisces: Pisces's month tends to run on inner tides — strong intuitions, soft edges, and a sensitivity to whose mood is in the room. The pattern often rewards staying in your own water and noticing where someone else's feelings end and yours begin. Empathy is the gift; absorption is its shadow. The arc asks what you need to set down before tonight.

webApp.monthlyHoroscopeDatingLensV2_pisces: In dating this month, Pisces can name their own impression first before absorbing the other person's — your read counts.

webApp.monthlyHoroscopeConversationPromptV2_tau: Try asking someone this month: "What's a slow, ordinary part of your life that you actually love?"
webApp.monthlyHoroscopeConversationPromptV2_gem: Try asking someone this month: "Of everything you're curious about right now, which one would you stay with for a whole year?"
webApp.monthlyHoroscopeConversationPromptV2_can: Try asking someone this month: "What does 'being looked after' actually look like to you on a normal day?"
webApp.monthlyHoroscopeConversationPromptV2_leo: Try asking someone this month: "When do you feel most seen — and who's usually around when that happens?"
webApp.monthlyHoroscopeConversationPromptV2_vir: Try asking someone this month: "What's something you keep refining that's probably already good enough?"
webApp.monthlyHoroscopeConversationPromptV2_lib: Try asking someone this month: "What's a small decision you've been postponing because every option feels acceptable?"
webApp.monthlyHoroscopeConversationPromptV2_sco: Try asking someone this month: "What's a feeling you've been carrying that you haven't said out loud yet?"
webApp.monthlyHoroscopeConversationPromptV2_sag: Try asking someone this month: "What's a horizon you're reaching for — and what's the closer one you're side-stepping?"
webApp.monthlyHoroscopeConversationPromptV2_cap: Try asking someone this month: "What would change for you if the next milestone never arrived?"
webApp.monthlyHoroscopeConversationPromptV2_aqu: Try asking someone this month: "What part of you would you like someone close to actually see?"

webApp.monthlyHoroscopeReflectV2_aries: What are you charging at this month that you haven't actually chosen on purpose? Where would slowing down by a step help you arrive faster?
webApp.monthlyHoroscopeReflectV2_taurus: What in your life this month is yours to keep, and what have you been holding only out of habit? Where could your body lead the next decision instead of your plan?
webApp.monthlyHoroscopeReflectV2_gemini: Which of the conversations and projects you started this month deserve another month? Which ones can you let go of without it being a loss?
webApp.monthlyHoroscopeReflectV2_cancer: Who in your circle gets your softest version this month — and is that giving you something back? What home-shaped thing have you been postponing?
webApp.monthlyHoroscopeReflectV2_leo: Where are you performing warmth this month versus simply being warm? Who would you like to be seen by, and have you let them close enough?
webApp.monthlyHoroscopeReflectV2_virgo: What are you refining that's already done? What would you do this month with the time you'd get back?
webApp.monthlyHoroscopeReflectV2_libra: Which 'maybe' in your life has quietly become a 'no' you haven't said yet? Which decision are you avoiding because the right one is the harder one?
webApp.monthlyHoroscopeReflectV2_scorpio: What's the unsaid thing in your closest relationship this month? What would loosen if you said it out loud?
webApp.monthlyHoroscopeReflectV2_sagittarius: Where are you reaching for a wider horizon to avoid the closer one? What would presence with the people in front of you make possible this month?
webApp.monthlyHoroscopeReflectV2_capricorn: What are you carrying this month that someone else could carry? Where would resting count as work?
webApp.monthlyHoroscopeReflectV2_aquarius: Where this month is your independence a window, and where is it a wall? Who would you like to let a step closer in?
webApp.monthlyHoroscopeReflectV2_pisces: What did you absorb this week that wasn't yours to carry? Where can your own impression go first before someone else's lands?
